grammar_title: 现在分词(V-ing)作表语和定语
source: 人教版2019必修三 Unit 1 Discovering Useful Structures:现在分词(V-ing)作表语、前置定语、后置定语。句子地道、围绕节日庆典主题;干扰项含 -ed 形 / to do / done,只有 V-ing(主动/正在进行)成立。

points.point: V-ing 作表语(描述事物给人的感受)
points.overview: 现在分词作表语,放在 be 等系动词后,说明主语(常为事物)所具有的、令人产生某种感受的性质。物用 -ing(amazing/exciting),人用 -ed(amazed/excited)。

points.point: V-ing 作前置定语(主动/正在进行)
points.overview: 现在分词放在名词前作定语,表示该名词主动发出动作或动作正在进行(exciting news, the rising sun, running water),相当于一个主动、进行的形容词。

points.point: V-ing 作后置定语(= who/which is doing)
points.overview: 现在分词(短语)放在名词后作定语,相当于一个主动的定语从句(the man standing there = who is standing there),被修饰名词是动作的发出者。

questions.stem: These floating lanterns on the river are truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 lanterns 是事物,描述它给人的感受 → 用 -ing 形 amazing;-ed 形 amazed 只形容人。

questions.stem: The dragon dance at the festival was really ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 dragon dance 是事物,作表语描述其令人兴奋的性质 → exciting。

questions.stem: The story behind this old custom is very ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 story 是事物,作表语 → touching(令人感动的);touched 形容人。

questions.stem: To be honest, the long parade became a little ____ after two hours.
questions.explanation: 主语 parade 是事物 → boring(令人厌烦的);bored 形容人感到厌烦。

questions.stem: The fireworks over the city were absolutely ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 fireworks 是事物,作表语 → stunning(惊艳的)。

questions.stem: The atmosphere at the carnival was so ____ that nobody wanted to leave.
questions.explanation: 主语 atmosphere 是事物 → relaxing(令人放松的)。

questions.stem: The noise of the firecrackers all night was quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 noise 是事物 → annoying(令人心烦的);annoyed 形容人。

questions.stem: The way they wash the streets clean after the tomato fight is ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 the way... 是事物 → surprising(令人惊讶的)。

questions.stem: The horse races at the Naadam Festival are truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 races 是事物 → thrilling(惊险刺激的)。

questions.stem: The samba performance was so ____ that the crowd cheered loudly.
questions.explanation: 主语 performance 是事物 → amazing。

questions.stem: The food festival sounded ____, but they didn't actually eat anything.
questions.explanation: 主语 festival 是事物 → interesting(有趣的);interested 形容人。

questions.stem: Watching the lanterns float away was a deeply ____ experience.
questions.explanation: experience 是事物 → moving(感人的);moved 形容人被感动。

questions.stem: The whole opening ceremony was quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 ceremony 是事物 → impressing/impressive 类的 -ing 形 impressing(令人印象深刻)。

questions.stem: Honestly, the speeches before the dinner were a bit ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 speeches 是事物 → tiring(令人疲惫的);tired 形容人。

questions.stem: The wrestlers' show of strength and grace was truly ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 show 是事物 → inspiring(鼓舞人心的)。

questions.stem: After dancing for hours in those heavy costumes, the day felt ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 day 是事物 → exhausting(令人筋疲力尽的)。

questions.stem: The colourful decorations in the square looked ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 decorations 是事物 → charming(迷人的)。

questions.stem: The riddles at the lantern fair were both fun and ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 riddles 是事物 → puzzling(令人费解的);puzzled 形容人。

questions.stem: For first-time visitors, the festival can be quite ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 festival 是事物 → overwhelming(令人难以招架的)。

questions.stem: The smell of roast turkey from the kitchen was really ____.
questions.explanation: 主语 smell 是事物 → tempting(诱人的)。

questions.stem: Families celebrating the Lunar New Year can enjoy ____ dragon dances.
questions.explanation: 前置定语修饰 dances,表示舞蹈令人兴奋 → exciting。

questions.stem: We sat by the river and watched the ____ moon rise slowly.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,月亮正在升起(主动/进行)→ rising moon。

questions.stem: There was a ____ story behind every lantern at the fair.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,故事令人感动 → touching story。

questions.stem: Children love the ____ lights on the Christmas trees everywhere.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,灯光正在闪耀 → shining lights。

questions.stem: The ____ crowds filled every street during the carnival.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,人群在跳舞(主动/进行)→ dancing crowds。

questions.stem: It is such a ____ time when the whole family gathers for dinner.
questions.explanation: 前置定语修饰 time → exciting time。

questions.stem: The ____ moon over the village was the highlight of the night.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,月亮在发光 → shining moon。

questions.stem: We could hear the sound of ____ water in the temple garden.
questions.explanation: running water 流动的水,前置定语表主动/进行。

questions.stem: The ____ news that the festival would be held again made everyone happy.
questions.explanation: exciting news 令人兴奋的消息,前置定语。

questions.stem: The ____ samba music made it impossible to sit still.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,音乐在跳动(主动/进行)→ beating music。

questions.stem: Everyone admired the ____ fireworks high above the river.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,烟花正在绽放 → bursting fireworks。

questions.stem: The ____ lanterns slowly drifted down the dark river.
questions.explanation: floating lanterns 漂浮的灯笼,前置定语表主动/进行。

questions.stem: It was a ____ sight to see thousands of lanterns in the sky.
questions.explanation: 前置定语修饰 sight → amazing sight。

questions.stem: The ____ fire dragon lit up the whole town square.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,火龙在旋舞(主动/进行)→ whirling dragon。

questions.stem: We followed the ____ parade through the old streets.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,游行队伍在行进 → marching parade。

questions.stem: The ____ smell of mooncakes filled the whole house.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,气味诱人 → tempting smell。

questions.stem: Their ____ performances on the green field amazed every visitor.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,表演鼓舞人心 → inspiring performances。

questions.stem: The ____ crops in the autumn fields meant a good harvest festival.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,庄稼在成熟(主动/进行)→ ripening crops。

questions.stem: A ____ smile spread across every child's face at the fair.
questions.explanation: 前置定语,笑容在扩大 → growing smile。

questions.stem: The ____ candles in the windows made the town look warm and bright.
questions.explanation: burning candles 燃烧的蜡烛,前置定语表主动/进行。

questions.stem: The families ____ the Lunar New Year enjoyed delicious mooncakes together.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were celebrating;families 主动庆祝 → celebrating。

questions.stem: Look at the lanterns ____ slowly down the river.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = which are floating;灯笼主动漂浮 → floating。

questions.stem: The man ____ there in the fancy robe is the festival host.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who is standing;man 主动站立 → standing。

questions.stem: The number of people ____ part in the tomato fight can reach 20,000.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who take part;people 主动参与 → taking。

questions.stem: I saw a lot of people ____ fancy Mongolian robes at the games.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were wearing;people 主动穿着 → wearing。

questions.stem: The dancers ____ their arms in the air looked just like eagles.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were waving;dancers 主动挥臂 → waving。

questions.stem: The children ____ for Easter eggs were laughing with joy.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were searching;children 主动寻找 → searching。

questions.stem: We watched the riders ____ their horses across the wide field.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were racing;riders 主动赛马 → racing。

questions.stem: The crowds ____ along the streets sang and cheered all day.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were marching;crowds 主动行进 → marching。

questions.stem: The friends ____ and talking around the table made the dinner lively.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were laughing;friends 主动欢笑 → laughing。

questions.stem: The visitors ____ the samba dance could not stop clapping.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were enjoying;visitors 主动欣赏 → enjoying。

questions.stem: There were many tourists ____ photographs of the bright lanterns.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were taking;tourists 主动拍照 → taking。

questions.stem: The people ____ in the square wished each other a happy new year.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were gathering;people 主动聚集 → gathering。

questions.stem: We admired the moon ____ brightly over the quiet village.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = which was shining;moon 主动发光 → shining。

questions.stem: The wrestlers ____ onto the green field were greeted with loud cheers.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were dancing;wrestlers 主动起舞 → dancing。

questions.stem: The relatives ____ lucky money to the children made everyone smile.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were giving;relatives 主动给压岁钱 → giving。

questions.stem: The students ____ traditional costumes performed a folk dance.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were wearing;students 主动穿戴 → wearing。

questions.stem: Everyone loved the choir ____ carols outside the church.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = which was singing;choir 主动唱歌 → singing。

questions.stem: The villagers ____ the church with flowers worked happily together.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were decorating;villagers 主动装饰 → decorating。

questions.stem: I noticed several families ____ a great feast in the town hall.
questions.explanation: 后置定语 = who were sharing;families 主动分享盛宴 → sharing。
